data.title: Air India upgrades partnership with KM Malta to codeshare agreement
data.description:
Air India has upgraded its partnership with Malta's national airline KM Malta to a codeshare agreement.

Both airlines had an interline partnership.

From December 1, Air India will place its 'AI' designator code on KM Malta Airlines-operated services between Malta and six major European destinations -- Amsterdam, Paris, Rome, Zurich, London Gatwick and London Heathrow, Air India said in a release on Friday.

A codeshare allows passengers to travel seamlessly on a single itinerary that combines flights operated by the two airlines.

KM Malta Airlines Executive Chairman David Curmi said India is an important market for Malta, with opportunities to grow both leisure and business travel.

 

The codeshare strengthens Air India's growing portfolio of partnerships that extend its global reach, the airline's Chief Commercial Officer Nipun Aggarwal said.

data.title: Zaggle up 7% from day's low on inking deal with Yokohama, WSFX Global Pay
data.description:
Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services rebounded by 5.8 per cent from the day's low of ₹157.50 in Friday's intraday deals after the company announced signing a forex services agreement. The stock hit an intraday high of ₹168.18 on the NSE. At 1:45 PM, Zaggle pared gains and traded on a flat note at ₹162.67 on trades of around 40 lakh shares on the NSE. The stock hit a 52-week low at ₹146.65 on October 26, 2026, and a 52-week high of ₹397 was registered on November 28, 2025. Zaggle stock has witnessed a significant downturn since hitting a record high of ₹592 in September 2024. At current levels, the stock trades over 72 per cent lower compared to its peak, and down 53 per cent on a year-till-date basis. 

Zaggle inks 'Tripartite Agreement' with Yokohama and WSFX Global Pay

Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services in an exchange filing on Friday, said the company entered into a tripartite agreement with Yokohama Private Limited (Customer) and WSFX Global Pay Limited (WSFX). 
ALSO READ: Stock Market LIVE: Shriram Fin, Bajaj Auto lead 700-pt loss in Sensex; Nifty below 25,700
 
 According to the terms of the agreement, Zaggle shall provide Expense Management System (EMS) to Yokohama, while WSFX shall act as the Authorised Dealer for forex services to Yokohama. Revenue from the agreement is variable in nature, and shall be in force for one year, unless terminated earlier. "The Quantum of fees is subjected to the number of international transactions made by the employees of the customer for the respective months on the Platform. "In such a case it would be difficult to ascertain the value/amount of the contract at this stage," Zaggle said in its release. Vijay Kedia bought stake in August Kedia Securities, owned by veteran investor Vijay Kishanlal Kedia, acquired 20 lakh shares, representing a 1.48 per cent stake in Zaggle in August. Kedia bought 20 lakh equity shares at ₹164.72 per share, for an aggregate consideration of approximately ₹32.94 crore. Equirus Securities has 'Long' rating on Zaggle Equirus Securities has a 'Long' rating on Zaggle with a price target of ₹275 per share by March 2028. The brokerage said, Zaggle's Q2FY27 revenue execeded its estimate by 2.8 per cent, while Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortization (Ebitda) was in line. Zaggle's management expects EBITDA margins of 7-8 per cent and continue to prioritise cash conversion and disciplined capitalisation. "Around 65-70 per cent of DICE contracts have been novated, with the remaining transfers expected in 3QFY27. We see Zaggle well positioned to benefit from wider adoption of spend management solutions, while acquisitions strengthen client stickiness," said the brokerage. Even as Equirus maintained a 'Long' rating, the brokerage cut FY27/FY28 earnings estimates by 13.4 per cent/6.2 per cent citing moderate programme fee growth and the near-term profitability drag from DICE integration. "We expect technology expenses, DICE integration and Zagg.money losses to weigh on near-term margins and model a 7.8 per cent EBITDA margin for FY27E,", the brocaded added. Disclaimer: Views and outlook in this report belong to the brokerages and analysts cited. data.title: India-US trade pact nears finish as pathway takes shape: Piyush Goyal
data.description:
The India-US trade deal is “close to culmination”, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal said on Friday, indicating progress in negotiations days after Washington proposed a fresh tariff framework for Indian imports.
 
“The US trade deal is close to culmination. The process and pathway, which was always something which held back finalising the deal, is now taking some shape,” Goyal said while addressing the India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026 organised by TRUST Group.
 
His comments came after the US Trade Representative (USTR) proposed tariffs of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods following a Section 301 investigation. Washington has indicated that the rate could be capped at 17 per cent if India and the US conclude a reciprocal trade agreement addressing the issues raised in the investigation.
 
 
India has disputed the US finding of structural excess capacity in its manufacturing industries and has said trade-related concerns should be addressed through bilateral trade negotiations.
 
Goyal also said the India-European Union free trade agreement was expected to be signed later this year and could come into effect by March or April 2027.
 
The minister said India's FTA coverage had expanded sharply over the past few years.
 
According to Goyal, before 2014, India's trade agreements covered economies with a combined gross domestic product (GDP) of about $10 trillion. Nine agreements finalised in the past four-and-a-half to five years, covering 38 developed countries, have added markets representing about $60 trillion of GDP.
 
Together, India's preferential market access now covers economies with around $70 trillion of GDP, he said.
 
Another eight or nine agreements under negotiation could add around $15 trillion, taking the total to about $85 trillion out of global GDP of $115-120 trillion, Goyal said.
 
“Almost every country in the world wants to do an FTA with India. We will add another $15 trillion. $85 trillion out of $115-120 trillion of global GDP will see India as a trusted partner; will see opportunities for India’s businesses to take forward,” he said.
 
On crude oil, Goyal said markets were sometimes too quick to re-rate or de-rate India based on relatively small movements in global prices.
 
While higher crude prices affected the economy, concerns that may have been significant in the 1990s or early 2000s needed to be viewed differently today given India's larger foreign exchange reserves, remittance flows, foreign direct investment and broader export base, he said.
 
“This could be an important matter of concern when we had much smaller foreign exchange reserves, much smaller remittances coming into the country, much less foreign direct investments coming into the country,” Goyal said.
 
A few dollars of movement in oil prices could not determine India's economic trajectory over the next two or three decades, he said, pointing to the country's expanding exports and economy.
 
The government said India had exported more than $700 billion annually and was targeting $1 trillion of goods and services exports in the current financial year.
 
Goyal also urged large companies, public sector undertakings and infrastructure developers to increasingly use the bond market as their first source of financing, including for long-duration capital expenditure.
 
He called for a broader investor base for long-term debt, asking insurers, pension and provident funds and mutual funds to increase participation in longer-duration instruments and look beyond only AAA-rated issuers.
 
The country's financing ecosystem would need to match the scale and duration of investments expected in areas such as semiconductor manufacturing, power grids, data centres and infrastructure over the coming decades, he said.
 
Goyal also urged exporters and their financiers to turn the market access created through FTAs into investment decisions by adding manufacturing capacity and preparing to serve newly opened markets.

data.title: Former Nvidia executive under scanner over sale of servers to China
data.description:
After Jensen Huang, former Nvidia top executive Jay Puri's relationship with senior tech executive Cenly Chen is under the scanner amid a US investigation into the alleged diversion of the company's servers to China.

Puri, who previously led Nvidia's global sales operations, and Chen, Super Micro's former chief growth officer, dated for several years before marrying on March 7, 2026, the Wall Street Journal reported.

Puri's professional association with Chen has drawn attention because he oversaw Nvidia's global sales and chip allocation. Chen worked closely with the server maker's customers and had regular dealings with Nvidia.

"I never had to rely on personal relationships for professional gain," Chen told the Journal by email.

 

The Journal said Nvidia and Puri did not respond to its requests for comment. Chen now runs AI computing provider ChronoScale.

Puri stepped down as Nvidia's executive vice president of worldwide field operations. Nvidia said in a July securities filing that it expected him to stay on in a senior advisory role to help his successor, Nick Parker, take over.

Super Micro, meanwhile, told WSJ that Chen "did not manage Supermicro's overall relationship with Nvidia or our procurement of Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs)". It said that a process involving several departments determined how the company allocated Nvidia chips to its customers.

On March 19, the US Justice Department announced charges against a Super Micro co-founder, a sales manager and a third-party broker. They were accused of conspiring to smuggle more than USD 500 million worth of servers containing advanced Nvidia chips into China.

The investigation also involves allegations that servers worth $2.5 billion were sold to Chinese customers through a Singapore-based front company.

The FBI has reportedly questioned a person familiar with Super Micro and sought information about senior executives, including Chen.

The report comes as Nvidia deals with revelations about co-founder Huang's extramarital affair with an executive at Megaspeed International.

That executive is suspected by some US officials of having worked with Chinese intelligence. Huang resigned from NVIDIA but returned as CEO this week, after US President Donald Trump intervened with the company's board.

data.title: Bosch announces record date for stock split, bonus issue; key details
data.description:
Bosch Ltd has announced the record date for the sub-division (stock split) and bonus issue of equity shares. In an exchange filing on Friday, the company informed that December 23 has been set as the record date for the two corporate actions.
 
The record date will determine the eligibility of shareholders to receive the benefits of both corporate actions.
 
Under the sub-division, Bosch will split its shares of face value of ₹10 into five equity shares with a face value of ₹2 each. 
 
"Sub-division of 1 (one) equity share of face value of ₹10 each fully paid-up into 5 (five) equity shares of face value of ₹2 each fully paid-up," the company had said in a filing earlier this month.
 
 
Post stock split, the company will issue three bonus shares of ₹2 each for every one equity share of ₹2 held by eligible shareholders.
 
"Issue of bonus equity shares in the ratio of 3:1 i.e., 3 (Three) bonus equity shares of face value ₹2 (Rupees Two) each for every 1 (one) equity share of face value ₹2 (Rupees Two) each fully paid up," the filing added.
 
Consequently, Bosch shareholders holding one share will receive a total of 20 shares after the sub-division and bonus issue. 
Bosch sets record date for stock split, bonus issue
 
In other words, the stock split will reduce the face value of each share from ₹10 to ₹2, with shareholders receiving four additional shares for every share held. This will increase the number of shares from one to five. Subsequently, the bonus issue will entitle shareholders to three additional shares for every ₹2 share held after the split. 
ALSO READ: Stock Market LIVE: Shriram Fin, Bajaj Auto lead 600-pt loss in Sensex; Nifty below 25,700
 
Thus, one share of ₹10 face value will translate into 20 shares of ₹2 face value after both corporate actions are completed.
 
The combined effect of the stock split and bonus issue would reduce the share price to one-fifth of its pre-corporate action level. It will not change the overall value of an investor's holding. 
Meanwhile, Bosch Ltd shares traded 1 per cent higher at ₹49,273 on BSE around 2:30 PM.

data.title: IIFCL, UCO Bank eye debut dollar debt before RBI window shuts, say bankers
data.description:
State-run financiers India Infrastructure Finance Company (IIFCL) and UCO Bank plan to ​issue debut dollar-denominated bonds next month before the central bank's subsidised swap window closes, two merchant bankers said on Friday.
 
The plans come as US Treasury yields slide amid an unravelling of the global AI trade and investors ‌flocking towards safe-haven assets, making the window, ​which closes on December 31, ​more attractive.
 
IIFCL could raise around $500 million through a five-year debt issue, ​while UCO Bank could add to the $1 billion fundraising it has already approved with a smaller size of around $250 million-$300 million maturing in three or five years, the bankers said.
 
 
The bankers requested anonymity ​as the matters are still private, while IIFCL and UCO Bank ‌did not reply to Reuters emails for comments.
 
Some Indian firms had ​earlier pushed back their plans after a spike in Treasury yields made borrowing more expensive, the bankers said.
 
IIFCL recently held meetings with investors as part ‌of a non-deal road show ​and received a BBB long-term ‌rating from S&P earlier this month.
 
The debt of UCO Bank is ‌rated BBB by S&P and BBB- by Fitch Ratings.
 
In June, the ​Reserve Bank of India announced measures to stabilise the rupee, including a subsidised hedging facility for lenders and state-run ​firms to lower their overall borrowing costs.
 
Indian lenders have so far raised $13 billion under the scheme.
 
In September, National ‌Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development raised dollar debt worth $750 million through 10-year ‌papers at 6.1220%, or at a spread of 105 basis points above comparable US yields.
 
Power Finance Corp also raised $300 million through three-year bonds at a spread of 110 bps over US Treasuries.

data.title: Union Cabinet clears fresh women's quota bill linked to delimitation
data.description:
The Union Cabinet met here on Friday and is learnt to have cleared a fresh delimitation-linked women's reservation bill, which is likely to be brought before the special sitting of Parliament beginning next week.

Sources said the bill was brought before the special meeting of the Union Cabinet, which is expected to accord its nod to the fresh bill with some amendments to ensure that no state loses its representation in the Lok Sabha in proportion to other states after delimitation.

The Cabinet meeting was chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and was convened at 1 pm at Sewa Teerth to discuss the bill, which the government is keen to get passed in the special sitting of Parliament starting Monday.

 

The bill was brought in Parliament by the government during a special sitting in April, but it could not pass muster in the Lok Sabha.

The government has now claimed that it has the numbers to get the legislation through.

A two-thirds majority in both houses of Parliament is a must for a Constitutional amendment bill to get cleared.

Sources said the DMK and NCP, besides BRS, are expected to support the bill.

The opposition INDIA bloc is against the legislation and will be meeting on Saturday to discuss its strategy.

data.title: Angel One surges 7% on huge volume; stock nears record high in weak market
data.description:
Angel One share price movement

 
Share price of Angel One hit a 52-week high of ₹382.85, soaring 7 per cent on the BSE in Friday’s intraday deals amid heavy volume in an otherwise weak market. Analysts attribute the buying interest at the counter to expectations of a potential recovery in orders alongside growth in the margin trading facility (MTF) book. The stock quoted close to its record high of ₹390.04 touched on January 9, 2024.
 
At 02:20 PM, Angel One was quoting 6 per cent higher at ₹379.90, compared to a 0.85 per cent decline in the BSE Sensex. The average trading volume at the counter jumped over two-fold with a combined 31.03 million shares changing hands on the NSE and BSE.
 
 
In the past month, the stock price of the stock broking & allied services company surged 32 per cent against a 13.6 per cent rally in the BSE Sensex. Further, thus far in the calendar year 2026, Angel One’s market price zoomed 61 per cent compared to a 2 per cent decline in the benchmark index.
 

About Angel One, Q1 results

 
Angel One is one of India’s leading FinTech platforms, transforming how millions invest and build wealth. With a user base of over 40 million, the company offers a wide range of digital-first solutions across broking, credit mutual fund, advisory, wealth and asset management (AMC) and distribution of third-party financial products. 
ALSO READ: Stock Market LIVE: Shriram Fin, Bajaj Auto lead 800-pt loss in Sensex; Nifty below 25,700
 
With a sharp focus on scalable tech, Angel One integrates AI, machine learning and data-driven intelligence to deepen client engagement and retention. The company’s flagship Super App and developer-focused SmartAPI - an open API platform for traders—and Smart Money - a comprehensive investor education platform—are designed to serve users who are mobile-first, data-savvy and growth-driven, the brokerage said in a press release.
 
Angel One's average MTF book grew 21.4 per cent to ₹7,450 crore in September 2026 from ₹6,140 crore in June 2026. Management said the MTF book continues to grow well and remains an important contributor to interest income, as it reached a record period-end high of ₹8,200 crore in Q2FY27.
 
India is witnessing one of the largest wealth creation opportunities in its history, and technology is making financial services more accessible than ever before. Angel One’s management believes the next decade will belong to platforms that combine innovation, trust and execution at scale.
 
Angel One is evolving into an AI-powered financial platform designed to serve clients across trading and investing, wealth, credit and global markets. With strong foundations, multiple growth engines and a relentless focus on client outcomes, the management is confident in the company’s ability to create enduring value while contributing meaningfully to India's financial future.
 
Management sees significant potential in credit distribution. Angel is building this vertical in a disciplined manner with a long-term focus, particularly as it is in an early stage. Currently, only a small fraction of Angel’s client base accesses credit through the platform, which represents a major opportunity, given that these clients already avail over INR 1trn in personal loans annually from the broader market, the release stated.
 

Motilal Oswal Financial Services view on Capital Market

 
India's MTF book has grown over 5x from ₹28,200 crore in April 2022 to ₹1.5 trillion in November 2026, driven by regulatory tightening in derivatives, rising retail participation and increasing broker focus on revenue diversification.
 
Future & Option (F&O) restrictions like peak-margin requirements, higher contract sizes, fewer weekly expiries and increased securities transaction tax (STT); have encouraged retail investors to shift towards leveraged cash-market products. Nearly half the MTF book is deployed in non-F&O stocks, where MTF remains the primary avenue for overnight leveraged exposure.
 
Large discount brokers such as Groww, Zerodha and Angel One are scaling their MTF offerings to diversify beyond transaction-linked broking income, gaining share from bank-backed brokers. Access to low-cost funding, balance-sheet strength and funded client penetration will increasingly drive competitive positioning, Motilal Oswal Financial Services said in its capital market sector report.
 
At 0.3 per cent of market capitalisation, India's MTF penetration remains relatively low versus global markets, providing headroom for growth. MTF offers a structural growth opportunity for brokers and an incremental volume cushion for exchanges, albeit with rising concentration and regulatory risks, the brokerage firm said. Disclaimer: Views and outlook in this report belong to the brokerages and analysts cited. data.title: 3rd earnings upgrade in 2 decades: Jefferies lists stocks to play the trend
data.description:
Fiscal year 2026-27 (FY27) is trending differently, as India Inc. is set for its rare earnings upgrade. According to global investment bank Jefferies, MSCI India earnings estimates have historically been revised lower through the year, with downgrades in 18 of the past 20 completed fiscal years.
 
This time, Jefferies upgraded earnings per share (EPS) estimates by 1 per cent compared to the start of the fiscal year, making it only the third upgrade year in two decades, after FY12 (+1 per cent) and FY24 (+2 per cent). Economic growth has been revenue supportive, and we believe 4-year low margins could provide earnings support ahead.  
 
 
This, the brokerage said, is notable against an average c.10 per cent downgrade over FY07-26.  
 
"Revenue growth for Jefferies coverage ex-O&G/metals/financials accelerated for the fifth consecutive quarter to 21 per cent YoY in Sep’26, a 15-quarter high. This supported 19 per cent YoY earnings growth ex-O&G/metals despite EBITDA margins being near four-year lows. Going forward, while revenue growth may not accelerate further, we believe that margin improvements can provide support to earnings growth," Abhinav Sinha, along with other analysts, wrote in the Equity Strategy note shared on November 26.
 

Stocks to play upgrade cycle

Among sectors, the positive revisions within Jefferies coverage have been led by banks and non-banking finance companies (NBFCs), with 73 per cent and 71 per cent of stocks seeing FY27E EPS upgrades post Sep’26 results, while cyclical commodities (O&G, Metals) have also seen broad upgrades. 
ALSO READ: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex slumps 700 pts, Nifty below 25,700; Auto, IT down 1% each
 
Among stocks seeing consistent upgrades over the past two quarters, our preferred names include ICICI Bank, Kotak Bank, SBI, Bajaj Finance, Lodha, Lenskart, and Indian Hotels, said the investment bank. Reliance Industries and JSW Steel also stand out as preferred names where revision momentum has recently turned positive, it added.
 
On the flip side, Cement, Autos and IT saw higher downgrades post Sep’26 results. Among stocks with persistent downgrades over the past two quarters, where we have an Underperform rating, are LTM, Hyundai, Indus Towers, Tata Motors, TCS and Wipro, Jefferies noted.
 

Edge over EM peers

Jefferies also noted that India ranks first against its emerging market (EM) peers on earnings framework, as the potential slowdown in AI capex poses downside risks to Korea and Taiwan.
 
"While India’s EPS growth trails EM ex-AI majors (Samsung, SK hynix and TSMC) by 19ppt in CY26E/FY27E, it is expected to move to a 3ppt lead in CY27E/FY28E, pointing to an improving relative earnings outlook," it said.

data.title: SBI to increase lending under 'MSME Dream' to ₹50 crore by March 2027
data.description:
The State Bank of India (SBI) aims to increase lending under its 'MSME Dream' product, which gives small businesses collateral-free digital loans, to ₹50 crore by March 2027, a senior official said on Friday.

At present, the bank offers loans of up to ₹5 crore under the product launched in December 2023 and there has been some Closed User Group (CUG) selling of loans up to ₹10 crore at select branches, the official said.

"By November 30, we will increase the lending to ₹10 crore across all branches and will launch a pilot project to do loans of ₹50 crore each under the product on the same day," the official said.

 

The bank will increase the per loan borrowing under the product to ₹50 crore across all branches by March next year, the official said.

The country's largest lender has sanctioned ₹2.25 trillion under the 'Dream' product till now, the official said, stressing that the asset quality is also much better on such loans.

The gross Non-Performing Assets (NPA) ratio for loans under the product is under 0.50 per cent as against the level of over 1.50 per cent for the loans to the micro, small and medium enterprises, the official said.

A borrower fills in a set of details on a digital platform to check his or her credit worthiness, and a loan is sanctioned within 45 minutes by the engine, the official said.

Earlier, it used to take around a month to disburse a loan which has been now compressed to around a week using the digital inputs, he said.
